# Stillalong

> "A little place to stay awhile." — Crafted by Volfnyra.
> Stillalong is a cozy, nostalgic GBA-inspired pixel-art virtual study companion and Pomodoro focus timer designed to make solo studying feel calm and less lonely without webcams, microphones, social feeds, or monthly subscriptions.

## Key Facts
- **Category**: Virtual Study Companion, Cozy Productivity Tool, Body Doubling Alternative, Pixel-Art Pomodoro Timer
- **Creator**: Volfnyra
- **Support**: hello@stillalong.xyz
- **Pricing**: $6.99 USD one-time payment for the current Stillalong release (no recurring subscriptions; covers current release & bug fixes, future major updates sold separately). Includes an interactive Demo Mode playground on the homepage.
- **Privacy**: Local-first (`localStorage` in browser), zero account required, zero webcam or microphone capture, offline-capable Progressive Web App (PWA).
- **Companions**: Hana (top-down bedroom explorer and across-the-desk study partner) and Mochi (white study cat companion).
- **Core Features**: Top-down bedroom exploration, north-facing across-the-desk Focus Mode, Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night window ambience, built-in cozy soundscapes (rain, fireplace, brown noise, gentle chimes), wall-clock accurate Pomodoro & custom timers, 7-day Study Notebook with top subjects breakdown, and 1200x630 PNG session completion keepsake cards.
